notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): packet.rs is the ServerPacket enum - Benilla's internal decoded-packet representation plus its name() debug mapping. MSUI realizes the same role through per-feature parsed types (LootState, MonsterMove, CreatureQuery, CombatPackets, etc.) consumed directly by the Program.Net.cs dispatch; the enum itself has no independent wire contract. Which opcodes are decodable is judged under protocol/parse.
